title: Wall Mount Glass Shelf 16-Inch Triple Tier With Tempered Beveled Glass And Solid Brass Hardware | Golden Yellow | Allied Brass
body_html:
Upgrade your bathroom storage with a wall mount glass shelf that adds three tiers of organization in a crisp, contemporary design in Golden Yellow, which radiates warm, sunny energy that brightens any bathroom with cheerful, optimistic personality.

  • Golden Yellow transforms this essential into a conversation piece
  • Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
  • Solid brass hardware: Built with brass components for enduring support
  • Clean installation: Concealed screw mounting hardware for a streamlined look
  • Finish flexibility: Offered in multiple designer finish options to coordinate with modern bathroom hardware and contemporary bath accessories

Specs

  • Glass dimensions: 16 x 5 inches
  • Overall dimensions: 16 inches L x 5 inches W x 15 inches H
  • Glass thickness: 0.38 inches (3/8 inch)
  • Weight capacity: 6 lb
  • Mounting type: Wall mount
  • Included items: Glass shelf and all installation hardware
  • Screw size: #8 x 1 1/4-inch
  • Assembly required: No
  • Warranty: Limited Lifetime Warranty

One of the many coordinating accessories in the Allied Brass collection of products, this subtle glass shelf unit is the perfect complement to your bathroom decor.
